package org.gradle.wrapper;

import java.io.*;
import java.net.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.security.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.*;

/**
 * Small, dependency-free Gradle distribution bootstrapper provided because the
 * standard wrapper JAR could not be downloaded in the packaging environment.
 * This class is NOT the official Gradle wrapper; it downloads only the official
 * distribution URL and checks its published SHA-256 before running Gradle.
 */
public final class GradleWrapperMain {
    private GradleWrapperMain() {}

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        Path ownJar = Paths.get(GradleWrapperMain.class.getProtectionDomain()
                .getCodeSource().getLocation().toURI());
        Path root = ownJar.toAbsolutePath().getParent().getParent().getParent();
        Properties properties = new Properties();
        try (InputStream in = Files.newInputStream(root.resolve("gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties"))) {
            properties.load(in);
        }
        String distributionUrl = Objects.requireNonNull(properties.getProperty("distributionUrl"));
        String expectedSha256 = Objects.requireNonNull(properties.getProperty("distributionSha256Sum"));
        String zipName = distributionUrl.substring(distributionUrl.lastIndexOf('/') + 1);
        String gradleVersion = zipName.replace("-bin.zip", "");

        String gradleUserHome = System.getenv("GRADLE_USER_HOME");
        Path userHome = gradleUserHome != null && !gradleUserHome.isBlank()
                ? Paths.get(gradleUserHome) : Paths.get(System.getProperty("user.home"), ".gradle");
        Path cache = userHome.resolve("wrapper/dists/cse489-verified-" + gradleVersion);
        Path install = cache.resolve(gradleVersion);
        boolean windows = System.getProperty("os.name").toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).contains("win");
        Path bin = install.resolve(windows ? "bin/gradle.bat" : "bin/gradle");
        Path ready = cache.resolve(".verified-installed");

        if (!Files.exists(ready) || !Files.exists(bin)) {
            Files.createDirectories(cache);
            Path archive = cache.resolve(zipName);
            if (!Files.exists(archive) || !sha256(archive).equalsIgnoreCase(expectedSha256)) {
                System.out.println("Downloading verified Gradle: " + distributionUrl);
                Path temp = cache.resolve(zipName + ".part");
                download(distributionUrl, temp);
                if (!sha256(temp).equalsIgnoreCase(expectedSha256)) {
                    Files.deleteIfExists(temp);
                    throw new SecurityException("Gradle distribution SHA-256 mismatch");
                }
                Files.move(temp, archive, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
            }
            System.out.println("Extracting Gradle distribution (first run only)...");
            if (Files.exists(install)) deleteRecursively(install);
            unzip(archive, cache);
            if (!Files.exists(bin)) throw new IOException("Gradle executable is missing: " + bin);
            if (!windows) bin.toFile().setExecutable(true);
            Files.writeString(ready, expectedSha256);
        }

        ArrayList<String> command = new ArrayList<>();
        if (windows) { command.add("cmd.exe"); command.add("/c"); }
        command.add(bin.toString());
        command.addAll(Arrays.asList(args));
        Process process = new ProcessBuilder(command)
                .directory(new File(System.getProperty("user.dir")))
                .inheritIO()
                .start();
        System.exit(process.waitFor());
    }

    private static void download(String address, Path dest) throws IOException {
        URLConnection connection = new URL(address).openConnection();
        connection.setConnectTimeout(20000);
        connection.setReadTimeout(45000);
        try (InputStream src = connection.getInputStream()) {
            Files.copy(src, dest, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
        }
    }

    private static String sha256(Path path) throws Exception {
        MessageDigest digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256");
        try (InputStream in = Files.newInputStream(path)) {
            byte[] buffer = new byte[65536];
            int n;
            while ((n = in.read(buffer)) >= 0) digest.update(buffer, 0, n);
        }
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (byte b : digest.digest()) sb.append(String.format("%02x", b & 0xff));
        return sb.toString();
    }

    private static void unzip(Path zip, Path root) throws IOException {
        Path rootFull = root.toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        try (ZipInputStream entries = new ZipInputStream(Files.newInputStream(zip))) {
            ZipEntry entry;
            while ((entry = entries.getNextEntry()) != null) {
                Path dest = rootFull.resolve(entry.getName()).normalize();
                if (!dest.startsWith(rootFull)) throw new SecurityException("Unsafe archive entry");
                if (entry.isDirectory()) Files.createDirectories(dest);
                else {
                    Files.createDirectories(dest.getParent());
                    Files.copy(entries, dest, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
                }
                entries.closeEntry();
            }
        }
    }

    private static void deleteRecursively(Path dir) throws IOException {
        try (var walk = Files.walk(dir)) {
            for (Path file : walk.sorted(Comparator.reverseOrder()).toList()) {
                Files.deleteIfExists(file);
            }
        }
    }
}
